entry.en: The passport must be valid for the proposed duration of the stay.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe ser válido durante la duración prevista de la estadía.
entry.quote: To enter Argentina, your passport must be valid for the proposed duration of your stay.

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth more than 10,000 US dollars must be declared.
entry.es: Hay que declarar el efectivo o los cheques de viajero por más de 10.000 dólares estadounidenses.
entry.quote: You must declare cash or travellers cheques worth more than 10,000 US dollars

entry.en: Immigration authorities no longer stamp passports on entry.
entry.es: Las autoridades migratorias ya no sellan los pasaportes al ingresar.
entry.quote: Immigration authorities no longer stamp passports on entry.

entry.en: Children aged 17 and under resident in Argentina need written permission from the non-accompanying parents to leave the country.
entry.es: Los menores de 17 años o menos residentes en Argentina necesitan autorización escrita de los padres que no los acompañan para salir del país.
entry.quote: Children aged 17 and under who are resident in Argentina need written permission (‘Autorización de viaje’) from the non-accompanying parents to leave the country.

entry.en: A yellow fever certificate may be needed for onward travel to some other countries.
entry.es: Puede hacer falta un certificado de fiebre amarilla para seguir viaje a algunos otros países.
entry.quote: You may need a yellow fever certificate for onward travel to some other countries, due to the risk of yellow fever in Argentina.

entry.en: Even travelers who need no visa must give the address of their first night's accommodation.
entry.es: Incluso quienes no necesitan visa deben indicar la dirección de su primer alojamiento.
entry.quote: Those persons not required to obtain a visa to enter the country are still required to provide the address of their first nights accommodation

safety.en: Political demonstrations are more common than in the UK and can occasionally turn violent.
safety.es: Las manifestaciones políticas son más comunes que en el Reino Unido y a veces pueden volverse violentas.
safety.quote: Political demonstrations and picketing are more common in Argentina than in the UK. Some demonstrations attract large numbers of people, and they can occasionally turn violent.

safety.en: In Buenos Aires thieves use a 'mustard scam', taking your bags while an accomplice pretends to help clean mustard off you.
safety.es: En Buenos Aires los ladrones usan la 'estafa de la mostaza': te quitan los bolsos mientras un cómplice finge ayudarte a limpiar mostaza.
safety.quote: A common form of distraction theft reported in Buenos Aires is the ‘mustard scam’. Thieves take your bags while an accomplice pretends to help you remove mustard they have sprayed on you.

safety.en: Armed robberies are a risk, and robbery victims should hand over cash and valuables without resistance.
safety.es: Los robos a mano armada son un riesgo; si te asaltan, entrega el dinero y los objetos de valor sin resistirte.
safety.quote: Armed robberies are a risk. If you are the victim of a robbery, hand over your cash and valuables without resistance.

safety.en: Book taxis in advance if possible, and if hailing one in the street use only a 'radio taxi'.
safety.es: Reserva los taxis con anticipación si es posible y, si paras uno en la calle, usa solo un 'radio taxi'.
safety.quote: Book taxis in advance if possible. If you hail a taxi in the street, only use a ‘radio taxi’. These have a clearly visible logo on the car doors.

safety.en: Argentina has a relatively high traffic mortality rate, and pedestrians should exercise extreme caution.
safety.es: Argentina tiene una tasa de mortalidad vial relativamente alta y los peatones deben extremar la precaución.
safety.quote: Argentina has a relatively high traffic mortality rate, with about 20 road deaths per day, and with more than 120,000 injured people each year, including tourists. Pedestrians should exercise extreme caution.

safety.en: There is a risk of earthquakes, particularly in Mendoza, San Juan, Salta and Jujuy provinces.
safety.es: Hay riesgo de terremotos, en particular en las provincias de Mendoza, San Juan, Salta y Jujuy.
safety.quote: There is a risk of earthquakes in Argentina, particularly in the provinces of Mendoza, San Juan, Salta and Jujuy.

health.en: Medical facilities are good but can be expensive, and public hospitals tend to be crowded.
health.es: Los servicios médicos son buenos pero pueden ser caros, y los hospitales públicos tienden a estar saturados.
health.quote: Medical facilities are good but can be expensive. Public hospitals tend to be crowded.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Argentina.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas zonas de Argentina.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Argentina.

health.es: El hantavirus está presente en Argentina.

health.en: Dengue, a mosquito-borne illness, is serious and potentially fatal.
health.es: El dengue, enfermedad transmitida por mosquitos, es grave y potencialmente mortal.
health.quote: Dengue, a mosquito borne illness, is a serious and potentially fatal illness.

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink though sometimes heavily chlorinated; in rural areas of the north you may prefer to be cautious.
health.es: El agua de la llave es potable aunque a veces muy clorada; en zonas rurales del norte quizá prefieras ser prudente.
health.quote: though tap water in Argentina is safe to drink, if sometimes heavily chlorinated, you may prefer to err on the side of caution in rural areas in the north of the country.

health.en: Yellow fever vaccination is recommended for those visiting the northern forests.
health.es: Se recomienda la vacuna contra la fiebre amarilla para quienes visiten los bosques del norte.
health.quote: Yellow fever vaccinations are recommended for those visiting the Northern forests.

help.en: The emergency numbers are 107 for an ambulance, 100 for fire and 911 or 101 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son 107 (ambulancia), 100 (bomberos) y 911 o 101 (policía).

help.en: Dial 107 or 911 and ask for an ambulance.
help.es: Marca 107 o 911 y pide una ambulancia.
help.quote: Dial 107 or 911 and ask for an ambulance.

help.en: The Buenos Aires Tourist Police can be reached 24 hours at +54 911 5050 9260.
help.es: La Policía Turística de Buenos Aires atiende las 24 horas en el +54 911 5050 9260.

help.en: The Mendoza Tourist Police can be reached 24 hours at +54 261 413 2135.
help.es: La Policía Turística de Mendoza atiende las 24 horas en el +54 261 413 2135.

getting_in.en: Buenos Aires has two airports: Ezeiza (EZE) for intercontinental flights and the more central Aeroparque Jorge Newbery (AEP).
getting_in.es: Buenos Aires tiene dos aeropuertos: Ezeiza (EZE) para vuelos intercontinentales y el más céntrico Aeroparque Jorge Newbery (AEP).
getting_in.quote: The city has two airports, Ministro Pistarini International Airport (EZE IATA) some 40 km southwest of central Buenos Aires and the more centrally located Aeroparque Jorge Newbery (AEP IATA).

getting_in.en: A prepaid taxi from Ezeiza is described as safer and more convenient than a taxi from the rank, which is much cheaper.
getting_in.es: Un taxi prepago desde Ezeiza se describe como más seguro y cómodo que uno de la parada, que es mucho más barato.
getting_in.quote: Getting a taxi at the rank is much cheaper but the prepaid taxis are safer and more convenient.

getting_in.en: Regular catamaran routes link Buenos Aires with Montevideo and Colonia in Uruguay.
getting_in.es: Rutas regulares de catamaranes unen Buenos Aires con Montevideo y Colonia, en Uruguay.
getting_in.quote: Regular catamarans routes link Buenos Aires with Montevideo and Colonia in Uruguay.

getting_in.en: The Buquebus ferry runs between Buenos Aires and both Colonia del Sacramento and Montevideo.
getting_in.es: El ferry de Buquebus opera entre Buenos Aires y Colonia del Sacramento y Montevideo.
getting_in.quote: The Buquebus ferry service operates between Buenos Aires, Argentina, and both Colonia del Sacramento and Montevideo, Uruguay.

getting_in.en: There are only short-distance international trains, from Encarnación (Paraguay) to Posadas.
getting_in.es: Solo hay un tren internacional de corta distancia, de Encarnación (Paraguay) a Posadas.
getting_in.quote: There are no long-distance international services to Argentina, only a short-distance train from Encarnación (Paraguay) to Posadas.

getting_in.en: Argentina has many easy-to-use border crossings with Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay and Brazil.
getting_in.es: Argentina tiene muchos pasos fronterizos fáciles de usar con Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay y Brasil.
getting_in.quote: Argentina has many border crossings with its neighboring countries Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay and Brazil, which are easy to use.

getting_around.en: Because regional trains are limited and flights cost more, buses are the most common way to travel between cities.
getting_around.es: Como los trenes regionales son limitados y los vuelos más caros, el autobús es la forma más común de viajar entre ciudades.
getting_around.quote: Since regional train service is limited and plane tickets are more expensive, bus travel is the most common way to travel from city to city within Argentina.

getting_around.en: Bus travel costs about US$4-5 per hour of travel, with Puerto Iguazú to Buenos Aires about US$100.
getting_around.es: El autobús cuesta unos 4-5 dólares por hora de viaje; de Puerto Iguazú a Buenos Aires unos 100 dólares.
getting_around.quote: It is not as cheap as it was before, with about US$4-5 for each hour of travelling (Puerto Iguazú to Buenos Aires about US$100).

getting_around.en: Travelers must show identification when buying plane or long-distance bus tickets.
getting_around.es: Hay que presentar identificación al comprar pasajes de avión o de autobús de larga distancia.
getting_around.quote: It is a government requirement that travellers produce identification when buying plane or long distance bus tickets.

getting_around.en: The rail network is very limited, and intercity buses offer better service and faster rides.
getting_around.es: La red ferroviaria es muy limitada y los autobuses interurbanos ofrecen mejor servicio y viajes más rápidos.
getting_around.quote: So, the rail network is very limited, and intercity buses offer better service and faster rides.

getting_around.en: Domestic flight prices are described as double for non-residents.
getting_around.es: Se indica que los precios de los vuelos nacionales son el doble para no residentes.
getting_around.quote: The prices for tickets are double for non-residents, so be careful with publicized ticket prices.

getting_around.en: Foreign driver's licenses are generally recognized, and drivers must be over 21.
getting_around.es: Las licencias extranjeras se reconocen en general y los conductores deben ser mayores de 21 años.
getting_around.quote: Argentina generally recognizes valid drivers' licenses from foreign jurisdictions. Drivers must be over 21.

money.en: The currency is the peso (ARS), symbol "$".
money.es: La moneda es el peso (ARS), con el símbolo "$".
money.quote: The official currency of Argentina is the peso (ISO: code: ARS), denoted by the symbol "$".

money.en: ATMs limit withdrawals on foreign cards to around AR$100,000 with a fixed fee of around AR$16,000 (February 2026).
money.es: Los cajeros limitan los retiros con tarjetas extranjeras a unos AR$100.000 con una comisión fija de unos AR$16.000 (febrero de 2026).
money.quote: Most machines have a withdrawal limit of around AR$100,000 and a fixed fee of around AR$16,000 (February 2026).

money.en: Credit cards are used less commonly than in the United States or Europe.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito se usan menos que en Estados Unidos o Europa.
money.quote: Credit cards are used less commonly in Argentina than in the United States or Europe.

money.en: Foreigners paying with foreign credit cards at hotels are not charged the 21% VAT charged to Argentines.
money.es: Los extranjeros que pagan con tarjetas extranjeras en hoteles no pagan el IVA del 21% que se cobra a los argentinos.
money.quote: In addition, foreigners using foreign credit cards at hotels in Argentina are not charged the 21% VAT charged to Argentines.

money.en: Leaving at least a 10% tip is considered kind and polite at restaurants, cafes, hotels and similar places.
money.es: Dejar al menos un 10% de propina se considera amable y cortés en restaurantes, cafés, hoteles y lugares similares.
money.quote: Leaving at least a 10% tip is considered kind and polite at restaurants, cafes, hotels, beauty parlors, barbers, ushers and car-washes.

money.en: The black market for currency is illegal and money may be confiscated if police catch you.
money.es: El mercado negro de divisas es ilegal y el dinero puede ser confiscado si te sorprende la policía.
money.quote: The black market is illegal, so take all possible precautions to avoid getting ripped off, and remember that your money may be confiscated if you are busted by the police.

etiquette.en: Cheek kissing is very common, especially in bigger cities, among and between women and men.
etiquette.es: El beso en la mejilla es muy común, sobre todo en las grandes ciudades, entre mujeres y hombres.
etiquette.quote: Cheek kissing is very common in Argentina, especially in bigger cities, among and between women and men.

etiquette.en: The Falkland Islands (Islas Malvinas) are a sensitive topic, especially among older generations.
etiquette.es: Las islas Malvinas son un tema sensible, especialmente entre las generaciones mayores.
etiquette.quote: The Falkland Islands (Islas Malvinas) are a sensitive topic in Argentina, especially among older generations.

etiquette.en: Domestic politics are highly polarizing and sensitive.
etiquette.es: La política interna es muy polarizante y delicada.
etiquette.quote: Domestic politics are highly polarizing and sensitive.

etiquette.en: Wearing jerseys of rival clubs or national teams, especially Brazil and England, may attract negative attention or confrontations.
etiquette.es: Usar camisetas de clubes o selecciones rivales, sobre todo Brasil e Inglaterra, puede atraer atención negativa o enfrentamientos.
etiquette.quote: be aware that praising or wearing jerseys of rival clubs or national teams (especially Brazil and England) may attract negative attention, rude remarks, or even lead to physical confrontations.

etiquette.en: Being late to casual appointments is normal, but punctuality is expected for business meetings.
etiquette.es: Llegar tarde a citas informales es normal, pero se espera puntualidad en reuniones de negocios.
etiquette.quote: it is normal for Argentines to be late for casual appointments and social events. However, punctuality is expected for business meetings.

etiquette.en: Adding ketchup or barbecue sauce to a steak is seen as disrespectful.
etiquette.es: Agregar kétchup o salsa barbacoa a un bife se considera una falta de respeto.
etiquette.quote: Adding ketchup or barbecue sauce to a steak is seen as disrespectful.

connectivity.en: Prepaid Movistar, Claro or Personal SIM cards can be bought at phone shops.
connectivity.es: Se pueden comprar SIM prepagas de Movistar, Claro o Personal en locales de telefonía.
connectivity.quote: You can get a prepaid Movistar / Claro / Personal SIM card for a few pesos / free at phone shops

connectivity.en: Registering a SIM may require entering your passport number.
connectivity.es: Para registrar la SIM puede hacer falta ingresar el número de pasaporte.
connectivity.quote: to register the SIM you might have to enter your passport (or any 9 digit) number

connectivity.en: Most cafés and restaurants offer free Wi-Fi, and you ask for the password.
connectivity.es: La mayoría de los cafés y restaurantes ofrece wifi gratis y se pide la contraseña.
connectivity.quote: Most cafés and restaurants offer free Wi-Fi with an advertisement in their windows.

connectivity.en: Public Wi-Fi is very common in Buenos Aires, with great speeds.
connectivity.es: El wifi público es muy común en Buenos Aires, con buena velocidad.
connectivity.quote: Public Wi-Fi is also very common in Buenos Aires with great speeds.
